status: source-and-retained-wire diagnosis; validation belongs to Main
symptom: Attempt005 ends with all H/M neighbours in ExStart. Its first bypass-a DD exchange carries the corrected master bit and completes the final sequence echo; a later round on all links stalls after initial DDs.
root_cause: Table.handleDBDesc rejects every state below ExStart. RFC2328 section 10.6 requires an Init neighbour's DD to execute 2-WayReceived, enter ExStart when adjacency is required, and process the same DD. In attempt005 M's initial DD arrives before its next two-way Hello on every H interface; the producer discards the only master negotiation packet in this round.
owner: internal/plugins/ospf/neighbor/dd.go: Table.handleDBDesc; shared 2-WayReceived transition in table.go
workaround: Wait longer, increase protocol timers, weaken readiness, or assume every peer sends another DD promptly.
workaround_rejected: These leave the RFC-required Init transition missing and cannot make the received first DD negotiate. The timer and readiness contracts remain unchanged.
source_fix: Share the existing Hello 2-WayReceived transition with handleDBDesc for stateInit, then retain the ordinary admission, role, duplicate and sequence checks. An Init DROther still becomes only 2-Way when neither router is DR/BDR.

excluded_old_cause.meaning: bypass-a now sends MS on its master Exchange DD and H echoes the sequence

wire_checks: All 11 captured DD receives have valid IPv4 and OSPF checksums. The six second-round initial sends are paired with receives. After line21611 no DD occurs in the retained trace, while two-way Hellos continue.
inference_boundary: Init at each master-DD arrival follows from the last Hello's absent local Router ID plus Table.hello's one-way transition; retained diagnostics do not contain a per-packet handler result. The data supports the missing Init transition but does not establish it as the only native convergence defect.
separate_observation: All retained H/M maintenance stacks are inside topology/origination processing; the latest receive loops are selecting. The trace contains no later DD retransmissions. This report does not diagnose a specific scheduling defect or alter deferred origination.
preserved_changes: The prior MS sender repair, deferred origination and SR changes remain in place.
verification: No build, test, runtime, formatter or validation command has run in this worker. Main must demonstrate red with the before-source overlay and green without it, then rebuild BOTH carrier and daemon and rerun native RSVP.
